items.text: A coding certificate costs money, and nursing already gives you a job.
The honest comparison is not coder against nurse in general.
Get any offer in writing before you resign.
The four questions test whether coding fits your life, and the three proofs test whether you can do the work.
If you stay in nursing for the patients and the movement, a desk may feel flat within months.
Sit with a working coder for a morning before you pay for any course.
